description:
Find cached notices by a named profile or explicit filters.

Regions are buyer voivodeships by Polish name ("mazowieckie") or TERYT code ("14");
unknown fields do not match a constrained filter.
Amounts must use the stated currency; no exchange-rate conversion is applied.
CPV codes or prefixes ending in * in exclude_cpv never count; a notice whose every code is excluded is left out.
Keywords match word starts in titles, descriptions and lot titles (lek finds leków; lek* is the same).
Use *term* for a substring anywhere in a word. A * elsewhere is an error.
keyword_fields=["title"] matches keywords_any in titles only; buyers keeps named contracting authorities.
total counts all matching saved notices. Use compact=true for notice summaries, then get_notice for details.
notice_kinds compares normalized kinds across sources; notice_types compares raw source values.
dedupe="procedure" groups matching publications and keeps the newest per procedure.
open_now excludes same-day date-only deadlines and notices with no known deadline.
keyword_matches identifies the configured inclusion terms and fields that matched.
coverage reports the requested publication window, covered intervals, last acquisition attempt and
acquisition status per source. Empty results outside coverage do not prove absence.

buyers.description: Only these buyers: name fragments (case- and accent-insensitive) or exact NIP/REGON; any one is enough.
buyers.title: Buyers

compact.description: Return short summaries; call get_notice for details.
compact.title: Compact

cpv.description: CPV codes or prefixes ending in *, e.g. ["33600000", "72*"]. A notice matches if any code matches.
cpv.title: Cpv

currency.description: Currency of value_min and value_max; no exchange-rate conversion.
currency.title: Currency

deadline_max_days.description: Only notices whose submission deadline is at most this many days from today.
deadline_max_days.title: Deadline Max Days

deadline_min_days.description: Only notices whose submission deadline is at least this many days from today.
deadline_min_days.title: Deadline Min Days

dedupe.description: "procedure" keeps only the newest publication per procedure.
dedupe.title: Dedupe

end.description: Last publication date to include, YYYY-MM-DD.
end.title: End

exclude_cpv.description: CPV codes or prefixes ending in * to ignore; a notice whose every code is excluded is left out.
exclude_cpv.title: Exclude Cpv

exclude_keywords.description: Words that exclude a notice when they match, with the same matching rules as keywords_any.
exclude_keywords.title: Exclude Keywords

exclude_scope.description: Where exclusions apply: the whole notice, or single lots.
exclude_scope.title: Exclude Scope

keyword_fields.description: Where keywords_any must match; default all three. ["title"] skips platform instructions and other boilerplate in descriptions. exclude_keywords still check every field.
keyword_fields.title: Keyword Fields

keywords_any.description: Words matched at word starts in titles, descriptions and lot titles; any one is enough. Use *term* for a substring anywhere in a word.
keywords_any.title: Keywords Any

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return, 1-500.
limit.title: Limit

notice_kinds.description: Normalized notice kinds compared across sources.
notice_kinds.title: Notice Kinds

notice_types.description: Raw source notice types, e.g. "ContractNotice" (BZP) or "cn-standard" (TED).
notice_types.title: Notice Types

offset.description: Number of items to skip for paging, 0-20000.
offset.title: Offset

open_now.description: true keeps only notices still open for bids today.
open_now.title: Open Now

profile.description: Start from this configured profile; explicit filters below override its fields. Read tenderkit://profiles for the list.
profile.title: Profile

regions.description: Buyer voivodeships by Polish name ("mazowieckie") or TERYT code ("14").
regions.title: Regions

start.description: First publication date to include, YYYY-MM-DD.
start.title: Start

value_max.description: Maximum estimated value as a decimal string, in currency.
value_max.title: Value Max

value_min.description: Minimum estimated value as a decimal string, in currency.
value_min.title: Value Min

name: search_notices
